name: sleep_paralysis_enchanted_creature_stays_tapped_through_its_untap_step
notes: Printed: 'Enchant creature / When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. / Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.' Cast on the opponent's untapped 2/2, it taps the 2/2; in the opponent's next untap step the 2/2 stays tapped while their other tapped creature untaps.
